verses.text: Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Judá, haton heb' winh tik t'a stzolal: Winhaj Fares, winhaj Hezrón, winhaj Carmi, winhaj Hur yet' winhaj Sobal.
Ha winhaj Sobal chi' smam winhaj Reaía, smam icham winhaj Jahat. Haxo winhaj Jahat chi' smam winhaj Ahumai yet' winhaj Lahad. Ha yinhtilal heb' winh ix kajnaj t'a Zora.

Ha winhaj Hur sb'ab'el yune' ix Efrata yet' winhaj Caleb. Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winh ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Belén. Ay oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winh, haton winhaj Etam, winhaj Penuel yet' winhaj Ezer. Ha winhaj Etam smam winhaj Jezreel, winhaj Isma, winhaj Ibdas yet' ix Haze-lelponi. Ha winhaj Penuel chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Gedor, haxo winhaj Ezer chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Husa.
Haxo winhaj Asur ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Tecoa, chawanh heb' ix yetb'eyum winh: Haton ix Hela yet' ix Naara.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' ix Naara chi', haton winhaj Ahusam, winhaj Hefer, winhaj Temeni yet' winhaj Ahastari.
Haxo heb' winh yuninal winh yet' ix Hela chi', haton winhaj Seret, winhaj Jezoar yet' winhaj Etnán.
Haxo winhaj Cos smam winhaj Anub yet' winhaj Sobeba. T'a yinhtilal winhaj Cos chi' ix kot winhaj Aharhel, yuninal winhaj Harum.
Ay jun winh skuchan Jabes, te niwan yelk'och winh t'a skal heb' sk'ab'yok. Ha ix snun winh ix ak'an skuch Jabes, yujto ix yal ix: Te ya ix hin ek' yuj jun wune' ix alji tik, xchi ix.

Ha winhaj Jabes chi', ix och winh ejmelal t'a sDiosal Israel, ix yalan winh t'ay: Tzin k'an t'ayach Mamin to tzak' ha wach'k'olal t'a wib'anh, yik niwan tz'aj hin makb'en, to tzach och wet'ok tzin ha kolanel t'a chukal, yik wach' max wab' sya'il, xchi winh t'a slesal chi'. Ix yak'an Dios masanil tas ix sk'an winh chi'.
Ha winhaj Quelub yuktak winhaj Súa, ha winh smam winhaj Mehir, haxo winhaj Mehir chi', smam winhaj Estón.

Haxo winhaj Estón chi' ay oxwanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Bet-rafa, winhaj Paseah yet' winhaj Tehina. Ha winhaj Tehina chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Nahas. Ha heb' yinhtilal heb' winh oxwanh chi' ek'nak kajan t'a Reca.
Haxo winhaj Cenaz ay chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Otoniel yet' winhaj Seraías. Chawanh pax heb' winh yuninal winhaj Otoniel chi', haton winhaj Hatat yet' winhaj Meonotai.

Ha winhaj Meonotai chi' smam winhaj Ofra. Haxo winhaj Seraías chi' smam winhaj Joab, haton winh ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a ak'lik Carisim. Icha chi' sb'i jun lugar chi', yujto hata' kajan heb' anima jelan sb'o'an tastak.
Haxo winhaj Caleb yuninal winhaj Jefone ay oxwanh heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Iru, winhaj Ela yet' winhaj Naam. Ha winhaj Ela chi' smam winhaj Cenaz.
Haxo winhaj Jahalelel ay chanhwanh heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Zif, winhaj Zifa, winhaj Tirías yet' winhaj Asareel.

Ha winhaj Esdras ay chanhwanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Jeter, winhaj Mered, winhaj Efer yet' winhaj Jalón. Ha winhaj Mered chi', ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix Bitia, yisil winh sreyal Egipto. Haxo yalyuninal winh yet' ix, haton ix María, winhaj Samai yet' winhaj Isba. Ha winhaj Isba chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Estemoa. Haxo junxo ix yetb'eyum winhaj Mered chi', aj Judá ix. Oxwanh yuninal winh yet' ix, haton winhaj Jered, winhaj Heber yet' winhaj Jecutiel. Ha winhaj Jered chi' ix b'ab'laj kajnaj t'a chonhab' Gedor, haxo winhaj Heber, ha t'a chonhab' Soco ix b'ab'laj kajnaj winh. Haxo pax winhaj Jecutiel chi', ha t'a chonhab' Zanoa ix b'ab'laj kajnaj winh.

Ha winhaj Hodías ix yik'laj sb'a winh yet' ix yanab' winhaj Naham. T'a yinhtilal heb' ix kot heb' garmita, ix kajnaj heb' t'a Keila. Hanheja' t'a yinhtilal winhaj Hodías chi' ix kot heb' maacateo, haxo t'a Estemoa ix kajnaj heb'.
Ha winhaj Simón chanhwanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Amnón, winhaj Rina, winhaj Ben-hanán yet' winhaj Tilón. Haxo winhaj Isi ay chawanh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Zohet yet' winhaj Benzohet.

Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Sela yuninal winhaj Judá, haton heb' winh tik: Winhaj Er, winh b'ab'laj kajnajnak t'a Leca yet' winhaj Laada, winh b'ab'laj kajnajnak t'a Maresa, smam yicham heb' sch'alan k'apak lino t'a chonhab' Bet-asbea. Hanhejtona' winhaj Er chi' smam winhaj Joacim yet' heb' anima kajan t'a Cozeba yet' winhaj Joás yet' winhaj Saraf. Ha winhaj Joás yet' winhaj Saraf, ix yik'laj sb'a heb' winh yet' chawanh heb' ix aj Moab. Slajwi chi' smeltzajnakxi heb' winh t'a Belén, icha chi' yaj stz'ib'chajkan t'a peka'.
Ha juntzanh heb' chi' tz'akum heb'. Ha t'a Netaim yet' t'a Gedera kajan heb', yak'nak serwil winh rey heb'.
Ha winhaj Simeón owanh heb' winh yuninal winh: Haton winhaj Nemuel, winhaj Jamín, winhaj Jarib, winhaj Zera yet' winhaj Saúl.
Ha heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Saúl chi' t'a stzolal: Winhaj Salum, winhaj Mibsam, winhaj Misma.
Haxo heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Misma chi', haton winhaj Hamuel, winhaj Zacur yet' winhaj Simei.

Ha heb' winh yuninal winhaj Simei chi', 16 heb' winh, wakwanh pax heb' ix yisil winh. Haxo pax heb' winh sk'ab'yok winh, malaj wal yuninal heb' winh, yuj chi' maj k'ib' sb'isul heb' winh icha yinhtilal Judá.

Ha heb' yinhtilal Simeón chi' ix kajnaj heb' t'a juntzanh lugar tik: T'a Beerseba, t'a Molada, t'a Hazar-sual, t'a Bilha, t'a Esem, t'a Tolad, t'a Betuel, t'a Horma, t'a Siclag, t'a Bet-marcabot, t'a Hazar-susim, t'a Bet-birai yet' t'a Saaraim. Hata' kajan heb' masanto yik ix och winhaj David reyal.
Ayto pax oyexo schonhab' heb': Haton Etam, Aín, Rimón, Toquén yet' Asán,
yet' masanil yaldea'il juntzanh chonhab' chi' masanto t'a chonhab' Baal. Haton juntzanh chonhab' chi' b'aj kajan heb' yet' yinhtilal icha yaj stz'ib'chajkani.

Ayik ix k'ib' sb'isul heb' yinhtilal Simeón chi', haton heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a skal heb': Winhaj Mesobab, winhaj Jamlec, winhaj Josías (yuninal winhaj Amasías), winhaj Joel, winhaj Jehú (yuninal winhaj Josibías, haxo winhaj Josibías chi' yuninal winhaj Seraías, haxo winhaj Seraías chi' yuninal winhaj Asiel) yet' pax winhaj Elioenai, winhaj Jaacoba, winhaj Jesohaía, winhaj Asaías, winhaj Adiel, winhaj Jesimiel, winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Ziza. (Ha winh smam winhaj Ziza chi' haton winhaj Sifi, yuninal winhaj Alón, yuninal winhaj Jedaías, yuninal winhaj Simri yuninal winhaj Semaías).

Yujto ix k'ib' sb'isul heb', yuj chi' ix b'at heb' t'a stojolal b'aj tz'em k'u, ix k'och heb' t'a slak'anil chonhab' Gedor. Ix sayan heb' b'aj swa nok' smolb'etzal nok' t'a stojolal b'aj sjawi k'u, t'a jun ch'olan b'aj skan jun chonhab' chi'.

Hata' ix ilchaj anh ank'ultak te ya'ax yuj heb', te wach' anh, te ay pax anh. Te lewan yek' jun lum lum chi', junk'olal yajek' heb', malaj tas tz'ik'an heb', haton ta' ek'nak kajan heb' yinhtilal Cam t'a peka'.

Ha t'a stiempo'al winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá, hata' ix jawi juntzanh heb' toxo ix b'inaj sb'i tik. Ha heb' satjinakel heb' anima kajan ta' yet' scampamento heb' yet' spat heb'. Jun'elnhej ix satel heb' smasanil. Haxo heb' ix kajnajkan t'a slu'um heb' chi', yujto te ay swa'el nok' smolb'etzal nok' heb'.

Hanhejtona', ay pax 500-xo heb' winh winak t'a yinhtilal Simeón chi' ix k'och kajan t'a lum tzalkixtak t'a yol yik Seir. Haxo heb' winh yuninal winhaj Isi, haton winhaj Pelatías, winhaj Nearías, winhaj Refaías yet' winhaj Uziel ayoch yajalilok heb'.
Ha heb' ix satanel heb' amalecita ayto'ek' ta'. Haxo heb' ix kajnajkan ta'.
